acceptance: Exact table row counts and zero orphan foreign keys at SF 0.01, 0.1, 1 and 10.
Owner-approved acceptance report (distributions and per-query row counts on DuckDB and DataFusion); golden per-table SHA-256 hashes and expected row counts frozen in BenchBox CI.
Delimited and Parquet bytes identical at 1, 4 and default threads on macOS arm64 and Linux x86_64.
N=3 medians meet the ADR budget: <= 8 s / <= 10 s at SF 1, <= 80 s / <= 100 s at SF 10, RSS <= 512 / <= 1,024 MiB.
description:
Synthetic-generator stage for joinorder_synthetic (docs/internal/adr/adr-benchbox-datagen.md (revised 2026-11-26, PR #4540), decisions 1 and 6). Fixed-block per-table RNG (rand_chacha pinned, owned sampling, integer or pure-Rust libm math), delimited and Parquet output, and a per-benchmark generator version bump. Delimited value formatting matches the legacy generator's precision (no padded decimals or microseconds).

Decision gate: the acceptance report comparing legacy and new distributions and every query's row count across DuckDB and DataFusion needs owner approval before golden hashes are frozen.

Guardrails: no fork of tpcgen-rs; no auto backend mode or silent fallback; Python stays the only manifest writer; heavy measurements only through make heavy-run with N=3 medians recorded in the PR body; budgets from the ADR table are the gate, and a miss goes to the owner rather than being waived.
